newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Scientific names new CFO, president.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Scientific names new CFO, president.

text.p: Pacific Scientific Co said Monday that David Schlotterbeck had been named president and chief operating officer, and that Winston Hickman had been named chief financial officer and senior vice president.
It said in a statement Monday that Schlotterbeck was most recently president and chief executive of VitalCom, a startup networking company.
The company did not name the officers Schlotterbeck and Hickman would succeed, nor did it give reasons for the changes in executive management.
Calls to the company's offices in California went unanswered.
